name: Article in conference proceedings
description: Academic paper presented at a conference and published in the proceedings

name: Journal article
description: Peer-reviewed academic article published in a scholarly journal

name: Chapter in edited volume
description: Individual chapter contributed to an edited book or collection

name: Book
description: Full-length published book or monograph

name: Thesis
description: Academic dissertation or thesis submitted for a degree

name: Informational Booklet
description: Short-form printed materials used to provide concise practical, promotional, or reference information
consolidation_reason: All four are short printed information carriers differentiated mainly by layout and marketing nuance rather than by a materially different knowledge-object type.

name: Guide/Manual
description: Reference-oriented instructional documents that explain a subject or tell the reader how to perform a task
consolidation_reason: 'Handbook', 'manual', and document-form 'guide' are near-synonyms in practice. Keeping them separate forces uploaders to make arbitrary wording choices rather than meaningful classification decisions.

name: Tutorial
description: Step-by-step instructional content showing how to perform a task or learn a process
note: Unified across document, video, and audio because the defining trait is step-by-step instructional intent, not medium.

name: Technical Report
description: Formal technical or project documentation, including reviews, specifications, and evidence-backed reports
consolidation_reason: These six labels mostly reflect project workflow jargon, document length, or packaging. For retrieval they behave as one family of formal technical documentation.

name: Presentation
description: Slide-based document used to present information, recommendations, training material, or problem-solving guidance
consolidation_reason: The meaningful commonality is slide-based presentation format. The current distinctions are purpose labels, and one deck can easily be informative, educational, and decision-supporting at the same time.
source_gap_note: Problem-solving presentation appears in the metadata guide PDF but is missing from data_model.subcategories.json; it is nevertheless absorbed into this consolidated target.

name: News & Communication
description: Short communication documents used for periodic updates, announcements, or concise policy-facing messaging
consolidation_reason: These items are all concise communication artifacts optimized for update, announcement, or policy messaging rather than for deep reference use.

name: Case study
description: Video presenting a concrete real-world case to illustrate lessons, outcomes, or general principles

name: Documentary video
description: Factual video presenting information about a subject in documentary form

name: Educational/Training Media
description: Audio or video content created primarily to teach, train, or explain a subject in a structured way
consolidation_reason: For non-document media, the practical distinction between educational/training content and guide-form content is weak. They all function as structured explanatory learning resources.
source_note: Guide is retained separately for documents as part of Guide/Manual; its audio/video use is absorbed here.

name: Recorded Session
description: Recording of a live or synchronous event such as a talk, webinar, seminar, or other session
consolidation_reason: All six are session captures. They differ by channel or event label, but from a retrieval perspective users are looking for recorded talks, webinars, seminars, or discussions.

name: Interview
description: Recorded interview content in which one or more people answer questions or share expertise
consolidation_reason: The semantic form is the interview itself. Splitting audio and video versions creates duplicate concepts without adding classification value.

name: Product Review/Testimonial
description: Video evaluating, demonstrating, or endorsing a product, feature, service, or practical solution
consolidation_reason: Both forms are evaluative or persuasive showcases centered on the perceived value of a product, feature, or service.

name: Q&A Session
description: Structured question-and-answer content in which an expert responds to audience or host questions
consolidation_reason: The defining structure is the Q&A format itself, not whether it was captured as audio or video.

name: Simulation video
description: Video presenting or explaining a simulated process, scenario, or phenomenon

name: Vlog
description: Personal or experience-led video log published online

name: Audio Program
description: Audio-native episodic or commentary-style content published as a program, magazine, or podcast episode
consolidation_reason: These three labels describe editorial packaging or host configuration rather than sharply different knowledge-object types. For users they behave as one family of audio programs.

name: Data Visualization
description: Visual artifact whose primary purpose is to communicate data, patterns, or summarised information
consolidation_reason: Charts, graphs, and infographics are all data communication visuals. The difference is presentational style, not retrieval intent.

name: Figure/Image
description: Standalone image or figure, whether static or motion-enabled, used to illustrate or explain content
consolidation_reason: Interactivity is an implementation property that can be modeled separately. The underlying content type remains a figure or image.

name: Map
description: Map-based visual representation of a whole area or part of an area
consolidation_reason: Static versus interactive is a delivery property, not a different map subtype.

name: Audio Data
description: Dataset composed primarily of audio or sound recordings
consolidation_reason: Preferred label normalised from auditory to audio for consistency with common technical usage.

name: Geospatial data
description: Dataset containing location-tied records such as coordinates, addresses, or other geographic references

name: Graph/Network Data
description: Dataset modelling entities and their relationships as graphs or networks
consolidation_reason: The metadata guide itself notes the theoretical similarity between graph and network data. In practice these are usually retrieved and processed as one family.

name: Image Data
description: Dataset composed primarily of images or other still visual records
consolidation_reason: Preferred label normalised from imagery to image for consistency with other modality labels.

name: Text Data
description: Dataset composed primarily of textual or natural-language records
consolidation_reason: Preferred label normalised from textual to text for consistency with common data modality naming.

name: Video data
description: Dataset composed primarily of videos or video-derived records

name: Agricultural Production Data
description: Dataset describing crop production, farm inputs, or yield outcomes
consolidation_reason: These three labels describe tightly coupled parts of the same agricultural production chain. Keeping them separate at subtype level over-fragments closely related farm datasets.

name: Environmental & Temporal Data
description: Dataset describing weather, climate, environmental conditions, or other time-indexed observations
consolidation_reason: 'Temporal data' is too generic as a standalone subtype because time is a property present in many datasets. Consolidating it with weather/climate creates a more practical environmental time-series bucket.

name: Analytical & Scientific Software
description: Software used for AI, scientific computation, modelling, or data analysis
consolidation_reason: These tools are all analytical software built to generate insights, models, or scientific results. Their separation is mainly based on implementation emphasis.

name: Business software
description: Software developed to support business or organisational processes

name: Data repository/database
description: Software system used to store, manage, and serve structured or unstructured data

name: Farm Management & Decision Support Software
description: Operational software that supports farm management, planning, and decision-making
consolidation_reason: FMIS is a domain-specific form of management and decision-support software. Users evaluating farm software will usually expect these tools together.

name: Educational/Training Software
description: Software created primarily for learning, training, or serious-game style educational interaction
consolidation_reason: The guide explicitly defines game here as a serious educational/training game, so it is better treated as a subtype of educational/training software than as a separate top-level software concept.

name: Simulation Software
description: Software that simulates the operation of a real process or system over time
consolidation_reason: Label normalised to make the software subtype explicit.
